scope: Complementary clinical territory vs explicitly healthy controls in an enriched retrospective release, not an all-comers or independent test.

endpoints.ASMI: Published P4 ASMI at its original threshold; clinical antero-septal acute MI.
endpoints.IMI: Published P4 IMI at its original threshold; clinical inferior acute MI.
endpoints.ALMI: Published V3AG auxiliary rank without released threshold and separately trained fixed PTB-XL head; clinical antero-lateral acute MI.
endpoints.ILMI: Published V3AG auxiliary rank without released threshold and separately trained fixed PTB-XL head; clinical infero-lateral acute MI.

references: Read and seal route-free scoring of all 549 ECGs first; only then join the audit V2 clinical labels. Different and compound territories, other diseases and missing records remain visible as unknowns.
split_rule: All publisher ECGs are held against existing weights; no test fitting or threshold changes. Cluster by source patient and exact signal components; historical cross-provider subject isolation not certified.
limitation: Provider clinical localization and healthy controls give a specific contrast. PPV/NPV are conditional on this enriched cohort. No patient care, no cascade, no LAE proxy, and no change to original released artifacts.
